$$V_{\text{new}} = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 V_{\text{face}} = \frac{1}{8} V_{\text{face}}$$
where $V_{\text{face}}$ is the volume contribution of the original face to the polyhedron $P_i$. For a tetrahedron, its entire volume is the volume of one regular tetrahedron face.
